audit.why: HARD 8/10 fits: 47.67% over 946 games and a kit purpose-built against dash assassins — passive fears and interrupts dashes, W is shield plus AoE, R resets on takedown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Content win[] reads Talon on all seven rows while the full layer reads Vex on all seven and the win rate is 47.67%. The packet's own defects line flags its Talon-7/7 levelChart as contradicting the data.
audit.why: The kit decides it: Vex's passive fears and interrupts dashes and marks nearby dashers, her W shields, and her R answers Talon's R — the full layer's Vex verdicts are the grounded side. The content chart and whys argued the opposite of the page's own HARD rating.
audit.corrected: win[0..6] flipped to Vex with all seven whys rewritten to match; full sides untouched (already Vex).

audit.whatIsWrong: Content calls Talon's R 'Bladeflurry' (whys[4], spikes[1].text) — real name Shadow Assault. Content puts Personal Space on the E slot — it is her W (E is Looming Darkness), and attributes the dash-interrupt fear to W/E when Riot's text puts it on the empowered-passive ability. 15 misgendered fields; cooldowns field had no digits; two pasted trade-string bullets.
audit.why: Kit: W Personal Space 16s rank 1 (shield), E Looming Darkness 12s (slow zone), R Shadow Surge 140s rank 1, passive fears and interrupts dashes.
audit.corrected: Names and slots fixed, pronouns fixed, cooldowns numbered, bullets rewritten.

audit.why: The fight-gating cooldowns — W 16s, passive charge, R 140s — are now numbered in breakdown.cooldowns.
